AirBnB. 712 Sam’s Dr Greenville SC
We had a booking through hopper to stay at this address. Don’t book here!! Don’t book through hopper!! We were never given any check in instructions for this property, and when I reached out to the host through the listed phone number it rang a restaurant in Columbia SC. I called hopper and the hopper representative called the number and also rang a restaurant in Columbia. And apologized as hopper had not obviously properly vetted the host. After which I was left to book another stay at 10:00 pm for our time in Greenville as hotels stop accepting check ins after 11:00 pm. I then looked to hopper for a refund on the AirBnB. I was denied 3 different times by Hopper a refund and was ultimately told to take it up with the host. Yes you guessed it, through the same phone number for the restaurant in Columbia! Needless to say I am more than fully disgusted with hopper and there customer service as they sent me to a call center in what sounded like India with zero satisfaction for having my money taken and no service rendered with a bogus phone number for contact! I can truly say that I will never recommend Hopper to anyone or use their services again!!!

Fully refundable tickets. WARNING!! DO NOT PURCHASE A FULLY REFUNDABLE TICKET FROM HOPPER!! IT IS NOT STATED IN THEIR POLICY TO MAKE THE CUSTOMER WAIT FOR 2-3 MONTHS TO RECEIVE THE REFUND! CALENDAR DAYS!!

This is a ridiculous amount of time for $363. I have complained numerous times but they keep giving me the same answer. Nowhere does it say on their website that refunds take 2-3 months. See below for their response. I also reached out to Avianca Airlines and they have put the responsibility solely on Hopper USA. 
This is Hopper’s response. 

Hopper: “Thank you for reaching out to us for an update on your refund request. We sincerely apologize for the wait and any inconvenience this may be causing. Please note that we’ve already submitted the request to the airline for processing on their end. While the standard timeframe provided is 60 90 days, refunds are often completed within approximately one month”. 
It’s been 5 weeks and counting…

SCAM: If you want to pay $1,200 for a hotel and never get to check-in, use Hopper. I booked a 4 night stay at a hotel months in advance and paid over $1,200 dollars. When I showed up to check in, the hotel told me my reservation had been cancelled a week prior and the room was occupied. No email from hopper. No notification from the app. 
I had to pay for a different hotel out of pocket. Apparently Hopper uses a third party to book hotels, and whoever this third party is cancelled my reservation due to double booking it. 10 days later and multiple phone calls to customer service (which was a painful process) and hopper refused to give me a refund. 

To be clear: I paid for a hotel, never received it (through no fault of my own) and never received a refund. What an absolute joke of a company. They basically stole from me.

Rental car in Athens. I booked a rental car in Athens through Hopper with Centauro Rent a Car and had a very disappointing experience. The airport shuttle took over an hour to arrive, and I had to make multiple calls late at night just to locate it.

More concerning was the pickup process. I declined the optional €350 insurance and attempted to leave the required deposit with several valid credit cards, but was told none of them worked. Strangely, the same cards were immediately accepted once I agreed to purchase the insurance.

The situation felt extremely misleading and pressured. I hope Hopper reviews its partnership standards with this rental provider to help protect future customers from similar experiences.

reviews.text:
Use Expedia Instead. If I could give zero stars, I would. This was a textbook bait-and-switch operation between Hopper and Dollar Rent A Car.
I booked and paid through Hopper, which explicitly stated that I owed $180 upfront and a final $37 in taxes at the counter. A simple, clear transaction or so I thought. When I actually got to the counter, Dollar refused to honor the agreed-upon price and demanded $136 in "taxes and fees." That is nearly a 300% increase over the confirmed amount.
Hopper’s "deals" are a total fabrication, and Dollar’s desk staff couldn't care less that their customers are being ripped off. Neither company takes responsibility, they just point fingers at each other while they reach into your wallet.
Do not trust the numbers you see on Hopper, and do not expect Dollar to behave like a reputable business. They are either completely incompetent or intentionally predatory. I’ll never use either of these garbage services again. Save your money and your sanity: go with a company that actually understands the concept of a binding contract.
